title: Nf Maxorder Om Higher
objective: Implement certified degree-raising higher OM representatives and a bounded second-order quotient basis beginning with x^4+4*x+4

handoff.summary: Adds normalized MacLane-chain valuations, higher Newton polygons, degree-raising binary linear-residual types, GMN quotient-denominator evidence, chain-aware MaxMin values, and exact degree-4/degree-8 Sage oracle fixtures. The mandatory x^4+4*x+4 case now returns an independently validated triangular basis. Nonmonic residuals are normalized to their monic associate, fixing pari-round4-vector-250 type construction.
risks: The certified higher lane intentionally covers only residue characteristic 2, degree-one residue fields, one higher side, and higher residual degree one; every other higher residual operator remains an explicit incomplete state.
The public pari-round4-vector-250 tree now validates, but its p=2 and p=5 quotient candidates fail independent multiplication closure and therefore remain rejected/fallback results.
Automatic selector enablement remains outside this lane and must stay disabled until broader differential crossover evidence is available.

The broad native tier reaches unrelated generated-FFI currentness/export failures; the changed-files architecture tier also sees the inherited number-field-algorithms package above its 400000-byte lazy budget. Root integration must rerun these tiers on current main-1.
next_steps: Implement the general higher residual coefficient operator over finite residue extensions and recursively process higher residual factors of degree or multiplicity greater than one.
Extend local quotient tables for higher types inside multi-branch factorizations and add exact Sage/PARI lattice comparisons before changing selector policy.
Use the source-transparent native compiler only after profiling identifies a stable hot mathematical kernel; dynamic CPython remains the correct fallback.
